 Meenakshi Ammal Educational Trust, which has been serving for the past 40 years, is
 the parent
 organization of Kanchi Vani Vidyalaya, Enathur , Kanchipuram.
KVV school
 celebrated its
 10th Annual Day on 21st March 2025, Friday, with great enthusiasm and grandeur,
 marking a decade
 of excellence. The event was graced by the Chairman, Director, Principal, and
 Administrative
 Officer, alongside esteemed guests and parents.
The evening began with a
 prayer, followed
 by the lighting of the ceremonial lamp, symbolizing the illumination of
 knowledge.
A
 highlight of the event was the recognition of academic achievers, including Master
 Gurupreet J,
 the school topper for 2023-24. The festivities continued with captivating cultural
 performances
 by students, including a dramatic Ramayana portrayal, vibrant Goan dances, Snow
 white and the
 seven dwarfs - an English fairy tale and dynamic performances in Irish and Salsa,
 Russian, African
 styles.
The event concluded with a vote of thanks and the National Anthem,
 leaving everyone
 with lasting memories. The evening was a fitting celebration of the school's growth,
 dedication,
 and commitment.

            const SPIN_FORWARD_CLASS = 'js-spin-fwd';
            const SPIN_BACKWARD_CLASS = 'js-spin-bwd';
            const DISABLE_TRANSITIONS_CLASS = 'js-transitions-disabled';
            const SPIN_DUR = 1000;

            const appendControls = () => {
                for (let i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
                    $('.carousel__control').append(`<a href="#" data-index="${i}"></a>`);
                }
                let height = $('.carousel__control').children().last().outerHeight();
                $('.carousel__control').css('height', (30 + (limit * height)));

            const setIndexes = () => {
                $('.spinner').children().each((i, el) => {

                    limit++;
                });
            }

            const duplicateSpinner = () => {
                const $el = $('.spinner').parent();
                const html = $('.spinner').parent().html();
                $el.append(html);
                $('.spinner').last().addClass('spinner--right');
                $('.spinner--right').removeClass('spinner--left');
            }

            const prepareDom = () => {
                setIndexes();
                duplicateSpinner();
                appendControls();
            }

            const spin = (inc = 1) => {
                if (disabled) return;
                if (!inc) return;
                activeIndex += inc;
                disabled = true;

                if (activeIndex >= limit) {
                    activeIndex = 0;
                }
                if (activeIndex < 0) {
                    activeIndex = (limit - 1);
                }

                const $activeEls = $('.spinner__face.js-active');
                const $nextEls = $(`.spinner__face[data-index=${activeIndex}]`);
                $nextEls.addClass('js-next');

                if (inc > 0) {
                    $stage.addClass(SPIN_FORWARD_CLASS);
                } else {
                    $stage.addClass(SPIN_BACKWARD_CLASS);
                }

                $controls.removeClass('active');
                $controls.eq(activeIndex).addClass('active');

                setTimeout(() => {
                    spinCallback(inc);
                }, SPIN_DUR, inc);
            }

            const spinCallback = (inc) => {
                $('.js-active').removeClass('js-active');
                $('.js-next').removeClass('js-next').addClass('js-active');
                $stage

                slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                    slide.classList.remove("active", "exit-left", "exit-right");
                    if (i === currentIndex) {
                        slide.classList.add("active");
                    } else if (direction === 1) {

                dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle("active", i === currentIndex);

                direction = -1;

            };
